transcript: Speaker A: शहर में ड्रीम जॉब मिली पर जब एयरपोर्ट वाली दोस्त से मिली तो मेरा कॉन्फिडेंस मिट्टी में मिल गया। वो फ्लूएंट इंग्लिश बोल रही थी और मैं बस हाँ-हाँ कर रही थी। क्या आपके साथ भी ऐसा होता है कि डिग्री होने के बाद भी इंग्लिश की वजह से पीछे रह जाते हो? [I got my dream job in the city, but when I met my friend who works at the airport, my confidence was shattered. She was speaking fluent English and I was just nodding along. Does this happen to you too, that despite having a degree, you lag behind because of English?] ... [Narrates her journey of feeling inferior, trying classes/courses, and finally finding 'English Seekho' app with short lessons and an AI coach named Disha, which helped her speak confidently at work and with her friend.] ... तो अपनी मेहनत को इंग्लिश की कमी पर मत रोक दो। इंग्लिश सीखो ट्राई करो। और अपनी जगह इस दुनिया में खुद बनाओ। [So don't let your hard work be stopped by a lack of English. Try English Seekho and make your own place in this world.] Speaker B: इंस्टॉल नाउ पर क्लिक करो और अभी इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
on_screen_text: shahar mein [in the city] ... English Seekho ... Install Now
summary: A young woman lands a job in the city but feels deeply insecure when she cannot converse in fluent English with her successful friend. After struggling with traditional classes and grammar-heavy courses, she discovers the 'English Seekho' app, which offers bite-sized lessons and an AI coach. She successfully improves her spoken English, gains confidence at work, and encourages viewers to download the app.
